title: 第19章 辐射区的危机第20章 平息能量泄露
lines: 一出铁城西门，天地顿时变了样。
城里那些整齐的灰白建筑、笔直硬实的道路、井然有序的守卫布置，全都留在了身后。放眼望去，再也看不见晴朗的天空，只有一层又厚又浊的灰雾，沉沉地压在地平线上，像块脏透了的裹尸布，把整片西部荒原严严实实地罩住。
风的感觉也彻底不一样了。
不再是铁城里那种冷冽干爽的穿堂风，而是黏糊、涩重、沉浊的空气，扑到脸上就贴在皮肤上，还带着细微的颗粒摩擦感。吸进喉咙，就是一阵隐隐的干疼。没什么异味，却比腥臭更让人窒息——这是高浓度辐射粒子在空气里飘浮流动的典型迹象，无声无息，却能蚀骨。
往前七十里，不见人烟，没有草木，听不到半点活物的动静。
整片大地被枯灰色的死土盖着，地面裂开一道道口子，像坏死的伤疤。裂缝深处渗着暗紫色的微光，一闪一闪，断断续续。每亮一次，就有一股细微的燥热从地底蒸上来，烘得空气更加凝滞。
苏野一路持枪警戒，枪口朝前，视线扫过前方大部分的盲区。
他目光不停，快速掠过每一个土坡、每一条地缝、每一片倒下的枯木，全身肌肉始终绷着，没放松过。废土荒原的平静从来不代表安全，只是杀戮还没现身。他不多话，只用最稳妥的战斗姿态，替所有人兜住前路的安全。
林小满的脚步越来越慢。
她眉头一直紧皱着，眼皮轻轻发颤，细密的精神感知全力铺开，像一张无形的网，罩住周围百里的范围。越靠近辐射核心区，她的感知丝线就刺得越痛，像有无数根细针持续扎着神经，一股钝麻的感觉从眉心一直蔓延到整条脊椎。
“能量很乱。”
她压着气息，声音轻得几乎被风吹散，克制里透着疲惫，“不是单独哪一处漏了，是整片地脉底层在持续溃烂、翻涌、失控。所有紊乱的能量都在往上顶，土层根本锁不住，只会漏得越来越厉害。”
陆寻脚步没停。
他左腿的旧伤在低气压和灾变能量的双重刺激下，泛起熟悉的酸胀钝痛。不致命，却磨人，时刻提醒着他：在废土生存，每一刻都藏着凶险。他走得不算快，但步幅稳，每一步都踩在扎实的土上，避开那些暗藏空洞的浮土和裂缝。
他抬手展开那张兽皮地图。
粗糙的皮面被风吹得微微发颤，上面的墨迹标记早已发暗，密密麻麻的圈层线条清晰地标出了辐射梯度——从浅灰到深黑，一层层递进。越往中心，标注的死亡警示就越刺眼。铁手盟的勘测数据没有半点夸张，甚至可能还弱化了这片灾地的恐怖。
“还有十里。”陆寻低声报出位置。
话音落下的那一刻，前方荒原的死寂，被一声沙哑干涩的怪响撕碎了。
声音粗粝刺耳，贴着地面窜开，带着畸变生物独有的诡异质感。
紧接着，三道灰影从左边土坡后突然窜出，速度极快，四肢扒拉着干裂的枯土，带起一片碎尘。体型还能看出是荒原沙鼠，却被高强度辐射彻底扭曲异化了——个头涨了两倍，皮毛掉了一大半，露出泛红溃烂的皮肉，眼球浑浊灰白，满嘴细密的尖牙闪着冷光。
三只畸变沙鼠，贴地疾掠，直扑三人侧翼。
没有试探，没有犹豫，只有刻进骨子里的嗜血本能。
苏野动起来快得只剩残影。
枪身微微一抬，没有多余瞄准，全是厮杀本能下的精准预判。
嘭、嘭、嘭。
三声短促干脆的枪响接连炸开，穿透厚重的灰雾。
每一发子弹都精准贯穿了畸变沙鼠的脑袋。高速动能瞬间击碎畸变的脑组织，三只正在飞扑的怪物在空中一僵，随即重重砸在枯土上，四肢抽搐几下，再也不动了。
倒地的尸体还在微微发烫，皮肉下的畸变能量还没散尽，表面泛着一层诡异的暗紫色光泽。
苏野顺势收枪，眼神一点没松，语气沉冷：“活跃度比铁手盟记录得更高，畸变程度还在加深。”
“不止。”
林小满突然按住太阳穴，脸色发白，气息微乱，“是群体性躁动。底层地脉能量暴涨，刺激了整个区域的异兽，它们全在被催发凶性，朝着失控的方向继续畸变。刚才那三只，只是探路的斥候。”
她话还没说完，远处灰蒙蒙的雾层里，细碎密集的窜动声层层叠叠响了起来。
沙沙、沙沙、沙沙——
无数声响从四面八方的土坡、裂缝、枯木底下传出，密集、杂乱、越来越近，听得人头皮发麻。整片死寂的荒原，正被无数潜藏的嗜血生灵彻底唤醒。
“继续推进。”
陆寻收起地图，眼底冷静得近乎冷酷。
零星的异兽只是表面威胁，真正的死局藏在辐射核心。周铁山无解的根源，从来不是能杀掉的畸变怪物，而是那个持续崩坏、不断外泄的地脉病灶。
又往前走了三里。
content_en:
As soon as we walked out of the west gate of Iron City, the world suddenly changed.
The city's neat gray buildings, straight and solid roads, and orderly guard arrangements were all left behind. Looking around, there is no clear sky anymore, only a layer of thick and turbid gray fog, weighing heavily on the horizon, like a dirty shroud, tightly covering the entire western wilderness.
The feeling of the wind is completely different.
It is no longer the cold and dry draft in the iron city, but the sticky, astringent, and turbid air that sticks to the skin when it hits the face, with a fine grainy friction feeling. When it is sucked into the throat, there is a dull dry pain. There is no peculiar smell, but it is more suffocating than the fishy smell - this is a typical sign of high concentrations of radiation particles floating and flowing in the air, silently, but capable of corroding bones.
For seventy miles ahead, there was no human habitation, no vegetation, and no movement of any living creature.
The entire land was covered with withered gray dead soil, and the ground was cracked with holes, like necrotic scars. A dark purple light seeped deep into the crack, flickering intermittently. Every time it lights up, a subtle heat steams up from the ground, making the air even more stagnant.
Su Ye was on guard with his gun all the way, the muzzle pointed forward, and his sight swept most of the blind spots ahead.
His gaze kept moving, quickly scanning every slope, every crack in the ground, and every piece of fallen dead wood. His muscles were always tense and never relaxed. The calmness of the wasteland never meant safety, it was just that the killings had not yet appeared. He didn't say much, and only used the safest fighting posture to ensure the safety of everyone on the road ahead.
Lin Xiaoman's pace became slower and slower.
She kept her brows furrowed, her eyelids trembling slightly, and her fine mental perception spread out with all her strength, like an invisible net covering the surrounding area of ​​a hundred miles. The closer she got to the radiation core area, the more painful her sensory threads became. It was like countless thin needles were constantly pricking her nerves, and a dull numb feeling spread from the center of her eyebrows to her entire spine.
“The energy is messy.”
She suppressed her breath, her voice was so soft that it was almost blown away by the wind, and her restraint revealed exhaustion, "It's not just any one place that's leaking, it's the bottom layer of the entire earth vein that continues to fester, surge, and get out of control. All the chaotic energy is pushing upwards, and the soil layer can't lock it in at all, and it will only leak more and more."
Lu Xun didn't stop.
The old injury on his left leg gave rise to the familiar soreness and dull pain under the dual stimulation of low air pressure and catastrophic energy. It's not fatal, but it's annoying. It reminds him all the time: Surviving in the wasteland is always dangerous. He didn't walk very fast, but his steps were steady. Every step he took was on solid soil, avoiding the loose soil and cracks that concealed cavities.
He raised his hand and unfolded the animal skin map.
The rough leather surface trembled slightly due to the wind, and the ink marks on it had already darkened. The dense circle lines clearly marked the radiation gradient—from light gray to deep black, progressively layer by layer. The closer to the center, the more dazzling the death warning is. The Iron Hand Alliance's survey data is not exaggerated in the slightest, and may even have downplayed the horror of this disaster area.
"There are still ten miles." Lu Xun reported the location in a low voice.
The moment the words fell, the dead silence of the wasteland ahead was torn apart by a hoarse, dry and strange sound.
"Hiss——"
The sound was rough and harsh, and it spread close to the ground, with a strange and strange feeling unique to aberrant creatures.
Immediately afterwards, three gray shadows suddenly sprang out from behind the soil slope on the left at extremely fast speeds. Their limbs pulled at the cracked dry soil and brought up a piece of dust. The body shape can still be seen as that of a desert gerbil, but it has been completely distorted and alienated by the high-intensity radiation - it has doubled in size, most of its fur has fallen off, revealing red and ulcerated flesh, its eyeballs are cloudy and gray, and its mouth is full of fine fangs shining coldly.
Three deformed gerbils flew close to the ground and pounced on the flanks of the three of them.
There is no temptation, no hesitation, only the bloodthirsty instinct engraved in the bones.
Su Ye moved so fast that only an afterimage remained.
The gun body was slightly raised, there was no redundant aim, it was all accurate prediction based on the instinct of fighting.
Bang, bang, bang.
Three short, crisp gunshots exploded one after another, penetrating the thick gray fog.
Each bullet accurately penetrated the head of the deformed gerbil. The high-speed kinetic energy instantly shattered the distorted brain tissue. The three flying monsters froze in the air, and then hit the dry soil heavily. Their limbs twitched a few times and stopped moving.
The corpse lying on the ground was still slightly hot, and the distorted energy under the skin had not dissipated, and the surface had a strange dark purple sheen.
Su Ye took advantage of the situation and retracted his gun, his eyes did not relax at all, and his tone was cold: "The activity level is higher than the Iron Hand League's record, and the degree of distortion is still deepening."
"More than that."
Lin Xiaoman suddenly pressed his temples, his face turned pale and his breath was slightly chaotic, "It's a group restlessness. The energy of the underlying earth veins has surged, stimulating the strange beasts in the entire area. They are all being stimulated to become ferocious and continue to distort in the direction of losing control. The three just now were just scouts exploring the path."
Before she could finish her words, a dense and dense sound of scurrying could be heard layer upon layer in the gray mist in the distance.
Swish, swish, swish——
Countless sounds came from the soil slopes, cracks, and dead trees in all directions. They were dense, messy, and getting closer, making people's scalp numb. The entire dead wasteland is being completely awakened by countless hidden bloodthirsty creatures.
"Keep pushing."
Lu Xun put away the map, his eyes so calm that they were almost cold.
The sporadic alien beasts are only surface threats, and the real dead end is hidden in the radiation core. The root of Zhou Tieshan's inexplicable solution has never been the aberrant monster that can be killed, but the terrestrial lesions that continue to collapse and leak out.
We walked another three miles.
title_en: Chapter 19 Crisis in the radiation zone Chapter 20 Calming down the energy leakage
